definitions.explanation: Oil extracted from plants, including seeds, nuts, and fruits. Used for cooking, food production, and industrial purposes. Contrasted with animal fats.

examples.japanese: {植物油|しょくぶつゆ}で{揚|あ}げる。
このお{菓子|かし}には{植物油|しょくぶつゆ}が{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Vegetable oil is used in these snacks.

examples.japanese: {動物性|どうぶつせい}の{脂肪|しぼう}を{植物油|しょくぶつゆ}に{置|お}き{換|か}えると{健康|けんこう}に{良|よ}いと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that replacing animal fats with vegetable oil is good for your health.

notes: Common types of {植物油|しょくぶつゆ} include {大豆油|だいずゆ} (soybean oil), {菜種油|なたねあぶら} (rapeseed/canola oil), オリーブ{油|ゆ} (olive oil), {胡麻油|ごまあぶら} (sesame oil), and ココナッツ{油|ゆ} (coconut oil). Often appears on food ingredient labels ({原材料|げんざいりょう}). Contrasted with {動物油|どうぶつゆ} (animal fat/oil). Compare with {食用油|しょくようゆ} (cooking oil — broader, includes any oil for eating). Also read as しょくぶつあぶら in some contexts.
